tickerText: [TENNIS] Barbora Krejčíková meets Maria Sakkari in the Athens Open final after edging Clara Tauson, while Gstaad and Båstad crown champions Sunday — Tsitsipas faces Collignon and Rublev meets defending champ Darderi • [SQUASH] Joachim Chuah and Rouqaia Othman remain Chennai Challenger champions as the PSA calendar turns toward the World Squash Masters in Perth from August 30 • [BADMINTON] PV Sindhu ends a 19-month title drought with her maiden Japan Open crown, beating Akane Yamaguchi 21-14, 21-17 on home soil in Tokyo • [PICKLEBALL] Georgia's first PPA Challenger wraps at Macon as 512 players close out pro and amateur brackets Sunday at Rhythm & Rally • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Feeder Ulaanbaatar opens in Mongolia with qualifying across all five events, while Sun Yingsha and teenage Sora Matsushima carry US Smash momentum toward Brazil's Star Contender

newsItems.title: Chuah and Othman Crowned Chennai Challenger Champions
newsItems.excerpt: Joachim Chuah beat Adham Roshdy 12-10, 11-7, 11-8 and Rouqaia Othman edged Hwayeong Eum in five games to claim the men's and women's titles at the HCL PSA Challenger in Chennai.

newsItems.title: Sindhu Wins Maiden Japan Open Title
newsItems.excerpt: PV Sindhu defeated Akane Yamaguchi 21-14, 21-17 in Tokyo to capture her first Japan Open crown and end a 19-month drought on the BWF World Tour.

newsItems.title: Macon PPA Challenger Concludes in Georgia
newsItems.excerpt: The 2026 Macon PPA Challenger wraps Sunday at Rhythm & Rally as 512 players finish pro and amateur brackets at Georgia's first PPA Challenger stop.

newsItems.title: WTT Feeder Ulaanbaatar Opens in Mongolia
newsItems.excerpt: More than 300 players from 30 nations begin qualifying at the Buyant-Ukhaa Sports Complex as Mongolia hosts its first ITTF world-ranking event through July 23.
